summary: Super Hi International Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited Q1 2026 financial results. The filing is a routine earnings report: revenue of $225.9M, increase of 14.2% YoY; 127 Haidilao restaurants; 4.0 table turnover rate; income from operation $14.0M, up 70.7%. No deal terms, strategic event, or special situation described. The Form 6-K is a standard foreign private issuer current report for earnings disclosure. What to watch: continued operational performance and restaurant expansion pace.
